answer: Every identity files a lotus-stamped census return and locks a 70-credit bond. Returns sit in a public tundra registry; auditors replay each filing against the work log. Each epoch a gale beacon recounts 5%; the same work under two identities burns both bonds. Filing costs 35 first, then 35+7(k-1) per identity, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,531,500 against a 40,000 pool — a rented-census ring loses. An honest agent files once for 35 and keeps its share.
